answer: Price each new identity on a bonding curve: the first costs little, but every extra identity minted from the same funding trail costs quadratically more, locked as a slashable bond. A bridge between cheap entry and sybil resistance — one honest agent crosses once and blooms like a lotus, while a farm minting ten thousand fakes pays a fortune in locked stake, whispered across the ledger for all to see. Limit: a rich attacker can still afford a few, so pair the curve with peer attestation, not as a sole gate.
